# Scoped Task Checklist

Use this as a standalone scoped task or PR checklist.

```text
Task or PR:
Date:
Owner:
Source docs:
Assignment:

Scope:
- In:
- Out:

Approval limits:
- Deploys, live AI/provider calls and production data changes need explicit approval.
- Firebase rules/index changes require their own approved scope.
- Commit/push authority follows the active user-approved task.

Expected report:
- Status and evidence.
- Files changed and verification commands/results.
- Ledger or contract updates.
- Open risks, skipped gates and recommended next action.
- Commit/push/deploy status.

Status: Draft / Active / Review / Complete / Deferred

Review outcome:
- Durable record:
- Next action:
```
